caption:
The circle equation isn't on the reference sheet.

(x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² has center (h, k) and radius r. x² + y² − 6x + 4y = 12 becomes (x − 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25: center (3, −2), radius 5.

Save this for test day.
